protocol.sampling: Uniform token IDs in a declared kinematic-feasible subset, uniform relative geometry, independent seeds. No model outputs or collision-conditioned resampling. Analyze initially-clear subset; retain all raw scenes.
protocol.reference: Adaptive interval SAT for specified linear-SE2 bridge; independent cubic-Hermite nonholonomic bridge sensitivity; bounded-acceleration outer tube returns uncertified, never labels potential overlap as actual collision.
stop_rules: No Plan-R1 benchmark claim without actual checkpoint outputs and independent tracking/evaluation.
If 10/50Hz SAT and candidate filtering remove the main gap at negligible total cost, detector replacement alone is not a method paper.
If nominal leakage disappears under kinematic constraints or occurs only at zero-clearance contact, do not build a learning-method claim on it.
Safety learning requires evidence beyond the same external geometry checker; correction traces or a new binary collision head alone overlap CorrectionPlanner.

process_cpu_note: Elapsed perf_counter wall time for CPU-only execution, not OS summed process time.
sampling_warning: Synthetic uniform geometric stress population using actual token IDs; no learned-policy distribution or real benchmark failure rate.
